verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer portal announces a first-party CLI that runs Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting. That headless server is backed by a localhost API (versioned, with an OpenAPI spec), which programmatic scripts can drive. The evidence is a single announcement line, though, with no documentation of CI usage, setup or authentication in non-interactive environments. Missing for 10: detailed headless CLI documentation, explicit CI/pipeline usage guidance, non-interactive auth/key provisioning docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Anytype CLI is now available - run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting.
Our API is now available and directly included with the desktop app, running entirely on localhost.
